$description: Runey public signed-out surfaces, measured 2026-11-19 on runey.app and runey.app/auth. Live theme is light: the page never applied the .dark class. The stylesheet has one prefers-reduced-motion rule, and it only sets .motion-reduce\:animate-none to animation:none. The public page did not use that class, so reduced motion was not shown to stop the page's own motion.
